title: Standards for Dispositions, Including Revocation of Permission (Re: Article 22(1))
full_text:
Standards for Dispositions, Including Revocation of Permission (Re: Article 22(1))
■ Enforcement Decree of Internet Multimedia Broadcast Services Act [Appendix 4] <Amended 2025. 10. 1.>

Standards for Dispositions, Including Revocation of Permission (Re: Article 22(1))

1. General standards

(a) Where there are two or more violations and the applicable disposition standards differ, the more severe standard shall apply. Where the standards for two or more violations prescribe the same type of disposition, namely suspension of business, the respective suspension periods shall be added together, but the total period of business suspension shall not exceed 1 year.

(b) When imposing a disposition suspending business, the Korea Media and Communications Commission may, taking into account the degree of the violation, suspend only part of the business for the business suspension period.

(c) Where the relevant violation is subject to suspension of business, the Korea Media and Communications Commission may increase or reduce the business suspension period by up to 1/2 of that period, taking into account the degree and frequency of the violation and other relevant factors; provided, even where the period is increased, the total period of business suspension shall not exceed 1 year.

2. Individual standards

| Violation | Applicable provision of the Act | Disposition standard |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Obtaining permission by fraud or other improper means | Article 24(1)1 of the Act | Revocation of permission |
| 2. Failing to commence business within 1 year from the date permission was granted, or continuously suspending business for 1 year or longer | Article 24(1)2 of the Act | Revocation of permission (business suspension for 6 months where there is a natural disaster or another unavoidable ground) |
| 3. Failing to comply with an order under Article 10(2) of the Act | Article 24(1)3 of the Act | Business suspension for 6 months |
| 4. Failing to comply with an order under Article 13(2) of the Act | Article 24(1)3 of the Act | Business suspension for 3 months |
